verdict.rationale: Mixpanel offers AI features, including agents that monitor the product, so letting those AI features use external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents Mixpanel acting as a hosted MCP server that gives outside AI assistants access to its data. That is the server role, not the client role this story asks about, so it earns no credit, and nothing shows Mixpanel connecting to third-party MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
